video_title: Can RJ, Channing and Perk Guess Their NBA Stats From the Year GTA 5 Dropped?

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on his experience playing Halo 2
quotes.excerpt: Halo 2 is the greatest first-person shooter game of all time.
quotes.quote: Halo 2 for me. That is how old I am. Halo 2, let me tell you this. Halo is the greatest first-person shooter game of all time.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on his connection with Steve Senior
quotes.excerpt: Steve Senior is the assistant GM for the Minnesota Timberwolves. Him and I go back.
quotes.quote: Scuba Steve. You guys might know him as Steve Senior. He is the assistant GM for the Minnesota Timberwolves. Him and I go back like four flats on a Cadillac. We were playing in Philly the night that it came out. He picked me up from Philly so after the game, I got in a car in Philly and he drove to Philly to pick me up. He wasn't even associated with the league or the Nets, but he drove to Philly to pick me up. So as soon as the game ended, I showered, I was still probably sweating, I talked to the media on my way out, I got in the car, we drove straight back to my apartment and we played it for eight to ten straight hours.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on the team's World of Warcraft obsession
quotes.excerpt: World of Warcraft was our thing. Even on the Knicks, we had land parties.
quotes.quote: World of Warcraft was our thing. Even on the Knicks, we had land parties. So there was seven of us in one room playing. Obviously, Malik Rose came from San Antonio where Tim Duncan and David Robinson were huge on it. And then they got Eddie Curry on it, and then they got all these other guys.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson on his 2013-14 season with the Utah Jazz
quotes.excerpt: I played a quick 82 games and I started 78 of them. We were trash.
quotes.quote: I played a quick 82 games. So just so everybody knows, I played all 82 games and I started 78 of them. We were trash. But mind you, this was year 13. I was coming off multiple injuries, so my whole thing is I wanted to play all 82 and I played, I started in 78 of them, caught a couple of bodies, and that is what got me to Dallas, which ended up getting me to Cleveland.

quotes.summary_phrase: Allie Clifton on her first viral moment in Minnesota
quotes.excerpt: This was my very first viral moment. This was when Pekovic was in Minnesota, Kevin was in Minnesota.
quotes.quote: This was my very first viral moment. This was when Pekovic was in Minnesota, Kevin was in Minnesota, different Kevin, but the ball hit me in the head during this hit and next next morning I was all over all the news.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on Nikola Pekovic's physical strength
quotes.excerpt: Pekovic was the strongest human being I have ever encountered in the history of basketball.
quotes.quote: Pekovic was the strongest human being I have ever encountered in the history of basketball. He had no business playing basketball. That dude was lifting up cars instead of weights in the weight room.
